note: Forecast source switch read by dist/weather.js. "multimodel" = dist/data/weather-multimodel/<region>.json first, Best Match (dist/data/weather/<region>.json) on any failure. Set to "best_match" to roll back. Operational choice; multi-model accuracy vs Best Match is not proven.
supabase_note: true = the app also reads the validated Supabase copy (weather-public/manifest.json, written by .github/workflows/weather-model-watch.yml); the newest fetched_at wins, so this GitHub data stays the automatic fallback. Set to false to stop reading Supabase.
